form: spread_raw = LINEAR*excess + QUADRATIC*excess^2 ; excess = max(0, debt/GDP - THRESHOLD)

anchors.threshold: Maastricht 60% reference + Reinhart & Rogoff (2010) EM debt threshold
anchors.linear: Hilscher & Nosbusch (2010, JF 65:1639): ~2.1 bp/pp linear elasticity
anchors.quadratic: Arora & Cerisola (2001, IMF Staff Papers 48:474): nonlinear acceleration

ci90_note: Hilscher-Nosbusch linear elasticity 90% range ~1.5-3.0 bp/pp -> LINEAR in [0.043, 0.086].
